title: mrp.bom — Bill of Materials routing, operations, byproducts L3
key_findings: mrp.bom.type has exactly two values in Community 19: normal and phantom (Kit); no separate 'kit' key
No routing_id field in Odoo 19 Community; mrp.routing.workcenter records are owned directly by the BOM via bom_id
mrp.bom.byproduct exists in Community 19 with cost_share (5,2 precision); total cost share must not exceed 100
mrp.routing.workcenter.blocked_by_operation_ids enables operation-level sequencing when allow_operation_dependencies=True on the BOM
Kit (phantom) BOM explosion on stock.move cancels the original product move and replaces it with component moves
_bom_find() prefers variant-specific BOMs over template BOMs; ordered by sequence, product_id, id
BOM versioning / mrp_plm is absent from Community 19 source tree
mrp.bom.line.product_qty allows zero (optional components); SQL constraint is >= 0 not > 0
operation_id on bom.line and bom.byproduct both restricted to operations on the same BOM via allowed_operation_ids relay
consumption field default is 'warning'; batch_size feature is opt-in via enable_batch_size Boolean
